content.title: Sub-Area Planning
content.summary: The City of Arvada has implemented Sub-Area Planning as part of its updated Land Development Code, focusing on specific areas designated for mixed-use development. Key plans include the W. 64th Avenue, New Town, Northwest Arvada, and Square Lake Sub-Area Plans, each addressing land use, urban design, and transportation within defined geographic areas to support future redevelopment and economic stability. Residents can engage in the planning process by providing feedback and signing up for updates.
content.body:
As part of the updated Land Development Code (LDC), the City of Arvada developed specific area plans for many of the corridors and areas zoned for mixed-use development. This is called Sub-Area Planning. These Sub-Area Plans focused on goals and policies for topics such as land use, urban design, architectural design and transportation. A sub-area plan includes a limited geographic area and is important for future redevelopment and the economic stability of the city.

The following plans were developed:

## W. 64th Avenue Sub-Area Plan

This effort to create a sub-area plan for the area generally defined as W. 64th Avenue between Simms Street and Yank Street will be incorporated into the new 2026-27 Comprehensive Plan. Read more on the [W. 64th Avenue Sub-Area Plan](https://www.arvadaco.gov/1041/Sub-Area-Planning-W-64th-Avenue) page.

## New Town Sub-Area Plan

The [New Town Sub-Area](/171/Sub-Area-Planning-New-Town) is generally defined as the areas along Wadsworth Boulevard and Bypass between the G Line tracks on the north and Interstate 70 on the south. The Arvada Marketplace shopping center along 52nd Avenue is also included in this area.

## Northwest Arvada Sub-Area Plan

The [Northwest Arvada Sub-Area](/172/Sub-Area-Planning-Northwest-Arvada) is generally defined as the area east of State Highway 93 to Gladiola Street, including the Indiana Street corridor, and between the railroad tracks on the south and the City boundary on the north.

## Square Lake Sub-Area Plan

The Square Lake Sub-Area is a collaborative project with Adams County that is generally defined as the area east of Sheridan Boulevard to Tennyson Street between 52nd Avenue on the south and 60th Avenue on the north. The City of Arvada portion of the Square Lake area is generally located east of Sheridan Boulevard to Tennyson Street between 58th Avenue and 60th Avenue.

The Arvada City Council adopted the final [Square Lake Sub-Area Plan (PDF)](https://library.municode.com/co/arvada/munidocs/munidocs?nodeId=68c12a5a37fc7) in August of 2022. For further information about the plan, visit the [Adams County sub-area plan website](https://adcogov.org/square-lake-subarea-plan).

## Engage in the Sub-Area Planning Process

Are you interested in receiving updates, being notified of open houses or providing feedback/comments to the City team regarding the Sub-Area Planning efforts?

- Please [add your comments or sign-up for email updates](https://arvada-forms.app.transform.civicplus.com/forms/32087).
